result.summary: The food delivery app page renders cleanly with no significant visual defects. The layout, typography, icons, and interactive elements appear consistent and properly aligned.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears as an outlined heart on a dark image background, while the heart on the pizza card below sits inside a dark circular background. Inconsistent heart icon backgrounds across cards may reduce visual consistency.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background treatment (e.g., a semi-transparent circle) behind all favorite icons to ensure visibility and uniform styling across all restaurant cards.
